newsitem.title: USA: Angelica acquisition to add $13 mln revs.
newsitem.headline: Angelica acquisition to add $13 mln revs.

text.p: Angelica Corp said Monday it acquired a cooperative laundry in San Bernardino, Calif., that is expected to add annual revenues of about $13 million.
The purchase of the laundry, formerly known as Automated Health System Laundry, was for cash and a promissory note.
The acquired business, which consists of customer contracts, linen and laundry equipment but not the building, will be operated as part of Angelica Textile Services Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary.
Angelica provides textile rental and laundry services to health care institutions and manufactures uniforms.
